method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- E1 (resource): state = "fresh".
- E2 (stage): mirror = "fresh".
- E3 (stage): mirror = "fresh".
Links:
- E1 → E2 (supports).
- E2 → E3 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- Rules depend on these attributes of E1: state.
- Rules depend on these attributes of E2: mirror.
- Rules depend on these attributes of E3: mirror.
- mirror of E2 equals state of E1 while E1 has an influencing link into E2; otherwise it is unset.
- mirror of E3 equals mirror of E2 while E2 has an influencing link into E3; otherwise it is unset.
